model_sql.first_valid_orders:
WITH valid_orders AS (
  SELECT *,
         paid_cents - refund_cents AS net_sales_cents
  FROM {{ ref('orders') }}
  WHERE status = 'paid' AND paid_cents - refund_cents > 0
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT *,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY member_id ORDER BY ordered_at, order_id) AS rn
  FROM valid_orders
)
SELECT order_id, member_id, ordered_at AS first_order_date, net_sales_cents
FROM ranked
WHERE rn = 1
model_sql.repeat_valid_orders:
WITH valid_orders AS (
  SELECT *,
         paid_cents - refund_cents AS net_sales_cents
  FROM {{ ref('orders') }}
  WHERE status = 'paid' AND paid_cents - refund_cents > 0
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT *,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY member_id ORDER BY ordered_at, order_id) AS rn
  FROM valid_orders
)
SELECT order_id, member_id, ordered_at, net_sales_cents
FROM ranked
WHERE rn >= 2
model_sql.monthly_member_orders:
WITH valid_orders AS (
  SELECT member_id, order_id, ordered_at, paid_cents - refund_cents AS net_sales_cents
  FROM {{ ref('orders') }}
  WHERE status = 'paid' AND paid_cents - refund_cents > 0
),
monthly AS (
  SELECT member_id,
         CAST(DATE_TRUNC('month', ordered_at) AS DATE) AS month_start,
         COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS valid_order_count,
         SUM(net_sales_cents) AS net_sales_cents
  FROM valid_orders
  GROUP BY member_id, CAST(DATE_TRUNC('month', ordered_at) AS DATE)
)
SELECT member_id,
       month_start,
       member_id || '|' || CAST(month_start AS VARCHAR) AS member_month_key,
       valid_order_count,
       net_sales_cents
FROM monthly

business_model_usage.quote: 一行一笔订单。保留订单识别、关联账户、渠道（门店或小程序）、下单日期、支付状态、原价、实付、累计退款、原始购买件数的含义。本期材料未提供订单实际使用哪张卡的关联
一行一份 CRM 会员账户；账户不等于跨系统自然人，也不等于自然人数。属性含注册日期、归属门店、会员等级
会员归属门店描述账户归属；订单成交门店描述交易发生门店，两者是不同关系，不可互相替代
已支付且实付减累计退款后大于零；取消与全额退款不计为有效购买。支付状态不等于有效购买；支付订单可以全部退款而仍不是有效购买。原始购买件数不是扣退货后的净销量
人数或金额统计需明确会员范围、期间、渠道、有效购买条件与来源；标签字段含义应结合实际填写核实
复购率 | 群体指标，定义与某期结果分开表达。定义需人群、资格纳入时点、期间、分子分母、有效购买条件与渠道；结果需定义版本、来源与覆盖
